# specsheet

> Cross-brand product specifications with provenance: every value links to the source that states it, and "unknown" never means "no". Free, open dataset (ODbL 1.0). A paid tier is coming later.

## Free dataset (static JSON)

- [Manifest](https://shrestha-pranav.github.io/specsheet/api/v1/manifest.json): categories, schema versions, index shards, release id
- [Categories](https://shrestha-pranav.github.io/specsheet/api/v1/categories.json): category list with counts
- [Identifier lookup](https://shrestha-pranav.github.io/specsheet/api/v1/lookup/identifiers.json): GTIN / model number to product id
- Per category: `https://shrestha-pranav.github.io/specsheet/api/v1/<category>/index-N.json` (rows), `facets.json`, `schema.json`, `products/<id>.json` (full record with per-value sources)
- [Data contract](https://shrestha-pranav.github.io/specsheet/api/v1/README.md)
- [Killer-query presets](https://shrestha-pranav.github.io/specsheet/api/v1/presets.json): ready-made questions (filters and columns as data), each with its measured fill and a pass/fail gate; a failing preset is a data gap, not an empty answer

## Categories

- air-purifiers: Air purifiers (217 products)
- chargers: USB chargers (142 products)
- laptops: Laptops (2419 products)
- monitors: Monitors (4306 products)
- power-banks: Power banks (168 products)
- power-stations: Portable power stations (75 products)
- power-strips: Power strips & surge protectors (538 products)
- robot-vacuums: Robot vacuums & mops (144 products)
- routers: Wi-Fi routers & mesh (334 products)
- ssds: SSDs (586 products)
- tvs: Televisions (1371 products)

## API and MCP (preview)

- Preview: a read-only HTTP API and an MCP endpoint may be offered later; limits and paths can change without notice.
- Until announced here, use the static dataset above.

## Rules

- Licence: ODbL 1.0; produced works include: "Data: specsheet (ODbL), sources linked per value". See https://shrestha-pranav.github.io/specsheet/#/terms and https://shrestha-pranav.github.io/specsheet/#/sources.
- Spec values come from the sources named per value, not independent testing. Check the source before a purchase.
- Corrections: a GitHub issue (https://github.com/shrestha-pranav/specsheet/issues). Takedowns: a GitHub issue (https://github.com/shrestha-pranav/specsheet/issues).
